name: omp-tokenplan-plugin
description: Tokenplan gateway provider plugin for Oh My Pi: apiKey auth, dynamic model list, model picked in /model

apiKey.description: API key for the tokenplan gateway (https://tokenplan.aipomogator.ru). Set via `tokenplan-install --token <key>` or `omp plugin config set omp-tokenplan-plugin apiKey <key>`.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outfile dist/extension.js --target bun --format esm
